# Imported MDX showcase

This fixture is a stand-in for an imported `.mdx` document. It flows through the
hardened pipeline (SPEC §6.1): allowlisted components render, unknown components
degrade to a neutral box, and raw HTML is sanitized against the tight schema.

<Note title="Anchoring note">
  Comments bind to the plain-text projection, not the markdown source, so
  **cosmetic** edits never move a highlight.
</Note>

<Warning>
  Re-syncing may orphan comments whose quote no longer matches.
</Warning>

## A component we do not ship

<ExperimentalWidget prop="ignored">
  Anything inside an unknown component is discarded.
</ExperimentalWidget>

## Raw HTML, sanitized

Press <kbd>Esc</kbd> to close. The following are neutralized on the way in:

<script>alert('xss')</script>

## Code stays code

```wat
(module (func $noop))
```

That unknown fence language renders as plain text — never a crash, never Kroki.
